description:
ASUS just dropped a massive bombshell at Computex with the brand new ROG Xbox Ally X20 (20th Anniversary Edition), and they have literally addressed every single complaint we had about the original! From a breathtaking 7.4-inch OLED display to completely overhauled TMR joysticks (say goodbye to stick drift!), this translucent black and gold beauty might just be the ultimate handheld gaming PC. Plus, we finally talk about the upgraded Micro SD Express slot—yes, it’s fixed!

Drop a comment below: Is the 7.4" OLED enough for you, or were you hoping for an 8-inch screen? What do you think of the new layout and specs? Let me know!
